# Expand legacy Jenkins C-regression coverage

## Summary

Update the existing non-Stellar Jenkins PR pipeline to compare the complete non-ignored C regression suite against its target-branch baseline, replacing its MOAT-only selection. Lua regressions remain out of scope to match Stellar’s current C-only CI path.

## Implementation Changes

- In `ci/jenkins/Jenkinsfile`, change both baseline creation and PR checking to use `runregression` with `--c-only` and without `--moat`.
